sourceStatement: Pedeir Keinc y Mabinogi, {branch}, from the White Book of Rhydderch (NLW Peniarth 4, c. 1350) as printed in J. Gwenogvryn Evans, The White Book Mabinogion (Pwllheli, 1907), {cite}; public domain. Readings are the manuscript's as Evans prints them, checked against the page images; word division, punctuation, capitals and quotation marks are ours. Where the White Book omits a word the sense requires, it is supplied from the Red Book (Rhŷs & Evans) and the note says so. Pronunciation convention: the manuscript spelling read with the sounds of Welsh c. 1300. Translations made fresh from the Welsh.
